structured.answer: A money-market fund (קרן כספית) only holds very safe short-term stuff. Right now it earns about 3.25% a year (not guaranteed) versus 0% in my current account, and I can take money out any trading day, so it looks right for money I might need soon. I still don't know what it costs: the page lists the fees but never gives a number.
